INTENT, RESPONSE, OUTCOME
Know what matters.
Keywords
Companions
Enemies
Charms
Sets

Hearth → Garden → Tide → Ember → Moon → Hearth. Advantage adds 1 break pressure, with no damage multiplier.

Cozy

Reduce direct damage by 10% per stack. Does not reduce scald.

buff · cap 3 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Scald

Lose 12 HP per stack at round end, bypassing shields. Steep removes one stack when healing.

debuff · cap 5 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Tangle

Direct hits add 1 break pressure per stack. Takes effect immediately.

debuff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Steep

Heal 18 HP per stack at round end and remove one Scald stack.

buff · cap 3 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Crumb trail

Stores 24 damage per stack for a detonation. Detonation consumes all stacks.

debuff · cap 4 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Scented

Can be targeted through front-row protection and takes 20% more direct damage.

debuff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Rattled

Direct damage dealt falls by 15% per stack.

debuff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Drowsy

Committed enemy signature becomes a half-power basic. Every actor still takes its turn.

debuff · cap 1 · 1 rounds · Dispellable
Glaze

Gain 20 shield per stack when starting a turn, capped at 60% maximum HP.

buff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Shelter

Hostile single-target intents prefer this actor while alive. Row-wide attacks remain row-wide.

buff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Saucer riposte

Each direct hostile hit returns 16 damage per stack. Reflections cannot trigger reflections.

buff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Hush

Enemy heal, summon or shield action becomes a basic. Cat energy skills cost 1 more.

debuff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Brittle sugar

Each direct hit removes an extra 15 shield per stack before damage.

debuff · cap 3 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Apron link

The living source takes 30% of direct HP damage to the linked ally. Shared damage does not chain.

buff · cap 1 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Second sprout

Consume to survive a fatal hit at 25% HP, once per battle per actor.

buff · cap 1 · 3 rounds · Protected from dispel
Yarn decoy

Absorbs the next direct hit entirely, then disappears. Scald passes through.

buff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable

Debuff success is 90% + Effect Hit − Effect Resist, bounded to 10–98%. Boss control lasts one round and grants a short control-resistance window.

Scald

debuff · cap 5 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Tangle

Direct hits add 1 break pressure per stack. Takes effect immediately.

debuff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Steep

Heal 18 HP per stack at round end and remove one Scald stack.

buff · cap 3 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Crumb trail

Stores 24 damage per stack for a detonation. Detonation consumes all stacks.

debuff · cap 4 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Scented

Can be targeted through front-row protection and takes 20% more direct damage.

debuff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Rattled

Direct damage dealt falls by 15% per stack.

debuff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Drowsy

Committed enemy signature becomes a half-power basic. Every actor still takes its turn.

debuff · cap 1 · 1 rounds · Dispellable
Glaze

Gain 20 shield per stack when starting a turn, capped at 60% maximum HP.

buff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Shelter

Hostile single-target intents prefer this actor while alive. Row-wide attacks remain row-wide.

buff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Saucer riposte

Each direct hostile hit returns 16 damage per stack. Reflections cannot trigger reflections.

buff · cap 2 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Hush

Enemy heal, summon or shield action becomes a basic. Cat energy skills cost 1 more.

debuff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Brittle sugar

Each direct hit removes an extra 15 shield per stack before damage.

debuff · cap 3 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
Apron link

The living source takes 30% of direct HP damage to the linked ally. Shared damage does not chain.

buff · cap 1 · 3 rounds · Dispellable
Second sprout

Consume to survive a fatal hit at 25% HP, once per battle per actor.

buff · cap 1 · 3 rounds · Protected from dispel
Yarn decoy

Absorbs the next direct hit entirely, then disappears. Scald passes through.

buff · cap 1 · 2 rounds · Dispellable
